phases.objective: Remove local development JWT fallbacks from tenant resource, docs, evolution, and lifecycle route families and require canonical parsed User-JWT output before tenant-scoped handlers.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: tenant resource, docs, evolution, and lifecycle routes mounted by their route builders
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: An unparsed bearer request is rejected, while a request carrying canonical User-JWT parser output reaches tenant membership, scope, or lifecycle guards without a local verifier or fallback secret.
steps: Load all tenant route-family sources and confirm they own no jsonwebtoken verifier or development fallback secret.
Pass a request with only an Authorization header to each route-local tenant guard and verify a typed 401 user_jwt_required response.
Pass a request with canonical req.auth mode=user_jwt and verify the normalized tenant guards consume the parsed principal.
Run the shared tenant route regression against workspace, platform plugin, resource, docs, evolution, and lifecycle route families.
assertions: No covered tenant route file contains the development_fallback_secret_only literal.
No covered tenant route file owns a local verifyJwt or verifyUserJwt helper or jsonwebtoken import.
Tenant route guards consume only req.auth produced by createUserJwtMiddleware().
An unparsed bearer cannot become tenant authority in any covered route family.
The regression exposes no secrets and does not require a live database or provider call.
